description: A colorful sticker activity sheet with a white axolotl outline is spread on the bed, with a separate page of sticker pieces on the right. The right hand lifts and peels a small pink sticker from the sticker page, then carries it left over the axolotl picture while the left hand steadies the sheet; both hands move in close as the right hand places the sticker onto the axolotl’s lower body and presses it down, with the left hand smoothing around the placement.
